d:
Chief Economic Adviser V Anantha Nageswaran joins The Indian Express Idea Exchange for a wide-ranging conversation on India’s economic outlook amid global uncertainty.
He discusses the risks of an AI-driven financial bubble and why a global correction could benefit India, the country’s growth prospects, job creation and the challenge of stagnant incomes. He also speaks about the economic cost of air pollution, China’s export restrictions on critical technologies, India’s push for indigenisation, private investment, welfare spending, energy security and climate adaptation.
